title: Import the receipt formatting function at the page entry
goal: Use the names export and import to share functions between two files.
summary: script.js is responsible for formatting; the module entry of index.html is responsible for click processing. Using relative imports like a normal web page, the practice sandbox will load script.js locally.
tasks: Complete and name the export formatReceipt(number) in script.js, return LAB- plus a serial number of at least three digits, and add 0 in front.
In the existing inline module of index.html, import formatReceipt from ./script.js. Updates the #receipt with the value of the #ticket when #format is clicked.

example.note: uses curly brackets to name the import, and the name corresponds to the export. The page entry must declare type="module".

hint: can be padded with String(number).padStart(3, '0'). Declarations in a module are only available in the module where they are located and need to be imported explicitly.
